# P1.11 — Assistant chat and the Research run (the Assistant seat end-to-end)

Spec: `docs/tickets/39_P1.11__assistant-and-research.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.11.md`
**Stage A only** — all code + deterministic tests. Stage B (dev deploy + migration `0033`, one
real chat turn + one real `research_burst`, ≤$5) is operator-gated → **D-P1.11-1**.

## Summary

The Desk Chat tab is a real surface and the Assistant seat is wired end-to-end (§7.1/§7.4/§7.6,
REQ-CHAT-1…14 + 19/20 + 29/30's surface half, REQ-SPEC-15, §16.3 #7). A new `@rhema/assistant`
leaf owns the domain: project-scoped threads (undeletable "Project chat" default; delete purges
thread-owned artifacts, preserves project-level research notes), pins (≤12, ≤300-token
summaries), the compaction brief, typed `read_artifact` refs, anchored ≤1-paragraph suggestions
(larger → `/lineedit`/`/revise` refusal), and the committed-read filter (a live run ⇒ the
assistant sees committed artifacts only). A chat turn is a `chat_turn` run through `createRun`
with frozen thread/turn/tier/budget/message-path inputs — the plan card IS the consent and emits
`chat.plan_card` with ids + counts only (never prose). `run_research` returns the
`research_burst` run-sheet link — it never creates a run. The turn read renders the cost strip
from metered `usage` rows + activity from `run_events`, and resolves `turn-result.json` via
`steps.produced_version_ids`. Attachments ride quarantine → `Converter.preview()` → canonical md
under `agents/assistant/research/attachments/` (images 415, cross-workspace keys 403).
Corrections land as Guidance `chat_promote`; "Paste my notes" writes `agents/author/notes.md`.

`@rhema/protocols` gains the first Rhema-owned skills — `chat-turn` (one `answer` phase) and
`research_burst` (`plan` judge → `fetch` bounded at the plan card's N → `distill` one note +
`research-result.json`), declared in the port manifest's new `rhemaOwned` list with the
drift-check extended to prove ownership. Burst outputs namespace under `burst-<runId>` (the new
`<run>` path template) and can only write `agents/assistant/research/` — the two-conduit rule is
a contract test, not a prompt. The run's consented URL policy + per-turn/proxy caps ride frozen
`runs.inputs` into `provisionRun` (`urlPolicyFromInputs` + `authorAssistantWebToolPolicy`).
The web layer mounts `ChatDesk` on every `/p/:slug*` pane (SSR forms, hidden `threadId`, zero
client JS) with same-origin POST forwards; migration `0033_chat.sql` adds the thread/agent-type
columns.
